analysis: To find the remainder when \( 7^{2023} \) is divided by 11, we can use Fermat's Little Theorem. Fermat's Little Theorem states that if \( p \) is a prime number and \( a \) is an integer not divisible by \( p \), then \( a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p} \). Here, \( p = 11 \) and \( a = 7 \), so \( 7^{10} \equiv 1 \pmod{11} \). We can express \( 7^{2023} \) as \( 7^{2020} \cdot 7^3 \). Since \( 2020 = 10 \cdot 202 \), we have \( 7^{2020} \equiv (7^{10})^{202} \equiv 1^{202} \equiv 1 \pmod{11} \). Therefore, \( 7^{2023} \equiv 7^3 \pmod{11} \). Now, we calculate \( 7^3 = 343 \). To find the remainder when 343 is divided by 11, we perform the division: \( 343 \div 11 = 31 \) with a remainder of 2. Thus, \( 343 \equiv 2 \pmod{11} \). Therefore, the remainder when \( 7^{2023} \) is divided by 11 is 2.
